items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: His name is Glen Gray Knoblauch, and we always called him Spike.

ctx.x: How did he get that nickname because I have seen it.
We have always called him Spike. His name is Glen Gray Knoblauch, and we always called him Spike.
I know I have seen that in the Encyclopedia but I have never seen him referred to as Spike in any of his -- publicly he was Glen Gray.
